name: Paper diorama
one_line: Cut-paper layers under a warm desk lamp.
look_words: A little world cut from coloured paper and stood up on a desk. Kraft-brown and sand paper for the ground, sage green and cream for hills and buildings, with pink and bright blue kept for the things that matter. Everything is a flat layer with a clean cut edge and a thin real shadow under it; depth comes from layers stacked front to back, not from detail. One warm lamp lights it from above, and the room behind is dark and soft. Motion is like a pop-up book: things slide, fold, tilt and swing on tabs. Avoid gradients, gloss, thin lines, realistic textures and anything that looks rendered rather than cut.

palette.name: cut paper
palette.notes: The sky is the dim room behind the desk. Pink is pickups, bright blue the goal; red paper only for harm. The player is navy so it reads against every paper colour.

look_wish: flat fills with a soft drop shadow under each layer, tilt-shift blur

upgrade.why: the lens blur that makes it look like a real model photographed on a desk

music.mood: slow, warm, music box and soft guitar
music.notes: Paper rustle as percussion works well.

sound_feel: paper slides, soft thuds, scissors snip, a page turning

Cut-paper diorama on a desk under a warm lamp, seen from the front like a little stage: layered paper hills in kraft brown, sage and cream, a paper river with a folded paper boat, a paper bridge, paper trees on tabs and a small navy-blue paper figure walking toward a paper windmill. Each layer has a clean cut edge and a thin real shadow, visible paper grain, dark soft room behind. Handmade and quiet.
